atoms.exact_source_text: Automatic population growth driven by a percentage rate, idle timer, or Nursery upgrade ladder.
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification excludes automatic population growth driven by a percentage rate, idle timer, or Nursery upgrade ladder as a non-goal.

atoms.exact_source_text: Disposable replacement births intended to compensate for expedition losses.
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification excludes disposable replacement births intended to compensate for expedition losses as a non-goal.

atoms.exact_source_text: A single visible population-cap number that ignores housing form, Load, care, and seasonal support.
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification excludes a single visible population-cap number that ignores housing form, Load, care, and seasonal support as a non-goal.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tier advancement as an RTS Age-up purchase, universal Citizen stat increase, or industrialization ladder.
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification excludes tier advancement modeled as an RTS Age-up purchase, universal Citizen stat increase, or industrialization ladder as a non-goal.

atoms.exact_source_text: Mandatory Guest recruitment, specific species recruitment, or collection completion as progression.
atoms.normalized_claim: The specification excludes mandatory Guest recruitment, specific species recruitment, or collection completion as progression as a non-goal.

atoms.exact_source_text: The roster counts Citizen subjects, not raw biological bodies and not Away body-units.
atoms.normalized_claim: The roster counts Citizen subjects rather than raw biological bodies or Away body-units.

atoms.exact_source_text: For almost every Citizen, one subject is one named animal.
atoms.normalized_claim: For almost every Citizen, one subject corresponds to one named animal.

atoms.exact_source_text: An authored collective-bodied Guest household may exceptionally be treated as one Citizen subject when the group is the smallest living unit the Colony can meaningfully know;
atoms.normalized_claim: An authored collective-bodied Guest household may exceptionally be treated as one Citizen subject when the group is the smallest living unit the Colony can meaningfully know.

atoms.exact_source_text: the detailed Guest roster defines those exceptions.
atoms.normalized_claim: The detailed Guest roster defines the exceptions to one-subject-per-named-animal counting.

atoms.exact_source_text: Away body-units are a separate expedition abstraction.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away body-units are a separate abstraction used for expeditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Several small Citizens may together occupy fewer Away body-units while remaining separately named, separately counted, and separately consequential at Home.
atoms.normalized_claim: Several small Citizens may together occupy fewer Away body-units while remaining separately named, counted, and consequential at Home.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Mouse Colony with eight Citizens has eight Citizens even when a particular expedition assembles them into fewer body-units.
atoms.normalized_claim: Example: a Mouse Colony with eight Citizens still has eight Citizens even when an expedition assembles them into fewer body-units.
